title: Security
summary: Use explicit boundaries and review practices when working with code, tools, and credentials.

sections.heading: Limit access
body: Give users and tools only the access they need for the current task.

sections.heading: Protect secrets
body: Keep credentials out of source files and documentation examples. Use environment-specific secret storage.

examples.code:
export VELCLAW_TOKEN="your-token"
# Never commit this value

sections.heading: Review sensitive changes
body: Require a deliberate review for changes that affect permissions, data handling, or delivery paths.
